data.title: Diamond Estates Wines & Spirits Announces Proposed Conversion of Debenture Principal and Interest
data.description:
Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 6, 2026) - Diamond Estates Wines & Spirits Inc.  ("Diamond Estates" or the "Company") announces that, on November 9, 2026, the aggregate principal amount of $4,654,000 outstanding under its 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures (the "Debentures") will be converted into common shares of the Company (the "Common Shares") at a price of $0.22 per Common Share, in accordance with the terms of the Debentures (the "Principal Conversion"). The Principal Conversion was previously approved by the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSXV") and the Company's shareholders.

The Company also announces that it intends to convert $1,470,400 of accrued and unpaid interest owing under the Debentures into Common Shares at a price per Common Share equal to the closing price of the Common Shares on November 6, 2026, being $0.13 (the "Interest Conversion").

The interest is payable to 3346625 Canada Inc. and Lassonde Industries Inc. The amount payable to 3346625 Canada Inc. is $1,140,000, and the amount payable to Lassonde Industries Inc. is $330,400. The total represents accrued and unpaid interest payable through November 9, 2026, the maturity date of the Debentures.

The number of Common Shares to be issued in respect of the interest will be determined using the November 6, 2026 closing price. The Company is seeking approval from the TSXV for the conversion of the interest into Common Shares. The Common Shares issued to settle the interest will be subject to a statutory hold period expiring four months and one day from the date of issuance, in accordance with applicable securities laws and TSXV policies.

MI 61-101 Disclosure

The participation of 3346625 Canada Inc. and Lassonde Industries Inc., each a related party of the Company, in each of the Principal Conversion and the Interest Conversion constitutes a "related party transaction" for the purposes of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101") and TSXV Policy 5.9. The Company is relying on the exemption from the formal valuation requirement in subsection 5.5(b) of MI 61-101 for both the Principal Conversion and the Interest Conversion, as the Company's securities are listed on the TSXV and are not listed or quoted on any of the specified markets set out in that subsection.

In respect of the Principal Conversion, the minority approval required under MI 61-101 was obtained at the Company's annual general and special meeting of shareholders held on October 30, 2025, in connection with the approval of the Debentures and their conversion terms. The resolution was approved by a majority of the votes cast by disinterested shareholders, with the votes attached to Common Shares held by interested shareholders excluded.

In respect of the Interest Conversion, the Company is relying on the exemption from the minority approval requirement in subsection 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101, as neither the fair market value of the subject matter of, nor the fair market value of the consideration for, the Interest Conversion, insofar as it involves related parties, exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization.

About Diamond Estates Wines and Spirits Inc.

Diamond Estates is a producer of high-quality wines and ciders as well as a sales agent for over 120 beverage alcohol brands across Canada. The Company operates four facilities, three in Ontario and one in British Columbia, that produce predominantly VQA wines under such well known brand names as 20 Bees, Creekside, D'Ont Poke the Bear, EastDell, Lakeview Cellars, Mindful, Shiny Apple Cider, Fresh Wines, Red Tractor, Seasons, Serenity and Backyard Vineyards.

Through its commercial division, Trajectory Beverage Partners ("Trajectory"), the Company serves as the sales agent for a wide range of leading international beverage brands.

Wine Portfolio:

Trajectory represents renowned wine brands, including Fat Bastard and Gabriel Meffre from France; Kaiken from Argentina; Kings of Prohibition from Australia; Yealands, Kono, Tohu, and Joiy Sparkling Wine from New Zealand; Talamonti, Cielo and Valdo from Italy; Bodegas Muriel from Spain; Porta 6, Julia Florista, Boas Quintas, Catedral and Cabeca de Toiro from Portugal; Fowles Wines from Australia; Empress Wines from Croatia; as well as C.K. Mondavi & Family, Charles Krug, Line 39, Harken, FitVine and Rabble from California. Trajectory also represents a broad portfolio of wines sold exclusively to restaurants, bars and private consumers.

Spirits Portfolio:

Trajectory also represents distinguished spirit brands such as Cofradia Tequila, Siempre Tequila, Chisme Tequila, Hussong's Tequila, Solmano Mezcal and Chica Chida Agave Spirit from Mexico; Islay Mist and Waterproof blended Scotch whiskies from Scotland; Glen Breton Canadian whiskies from Nova Scotia; Five Farms Irish Cream Liqueur from the UK; Tequila Rose Strawberry Cream, 360 Vodka and Holladay Bourbon from the USA; Giffard Liqueurs from France; Zubrowka Vodka from Poland and Becherovka from the Czech Republic.

Beer, Cider, and RTD Portfolio:

In the beer, cider, and ready-to-drink (RTD) categories, Trajectory represents Darling Mimosa, Protini Beverages from Ontario; Mountain Joe Hard Coffee, ESA Cocktails, Solmano Craft Cocktails, Stickler Shrub Cocktails, Sunday Session RTDs and Jasper Brewing Company from Alberta, and Warsteiner and Konig Ludwig from Germany.

For more information, please contact:

  • Andrew HowardPresident & CEOahoward@diamondwines.comContact number: 905-685-5673
  • Basman Alias Chief Financial Officerbalias@diamondwines.com

Early Warning Disclosure

Prior to the Principal Conversion and Interest Conversion, Lassonde Industries Inc. ("Lassonde") directly owns 32,846,506 Common Shares, $1,804,000 in principal amount of 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures of Diamond Estates and 773,288 deferred share units, which may be settled, at the discretion of Diamond Estates for up to 773,288 Common Shares.

Additionally, 3346625 Canada Inc., a corporation controlled by Mr. Pierre-Paul Lassonde and a joint actor of Lassonde ("Lassonde Holding" and together with Lassonde, the "Lassonde Group") directly owns 2,117,824 Common Shares and $2,850,000 in principal amount of 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures of Diamond Estates.

As such, prior to the Principal Conversion and Interest Conversion, the Lassonde Group holds 34,964,330 Common Shares, representing approximately 50.85% (on a non-diluted basis) of the issued and outstanding Common Shares, $4,654,000 in principal amount of 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures of Diamond Estates and 773,288 deferred share units.

Following the Principal Conversion and, subject to TSXV approval, the Interest Conversion, Lassonde will directly own 43,588,045 Common Shares and 773,288 deferred share units and Lassonde Holding will directly own 23,841,601 Common Shares. As such, subject to approval from the TSXV of the Interest Conversion, the Lassonde Group will hold 67,429,646 Common Shares, representing approximately 66.62% (on a non-diluted basis) of the issued and outstanding Common Shares and 773,288 deferred share units.

The Principal Conversion and Interest Conversion are being completed in accordance with the settlement terms of the Debentures. Such conversions must be completed pursuant to the terms of the Debentures as repayment of the principal and accrued interest amounts thereunder would not be permitted under certain restrictive covenants contained in the Company's credit facility with the Bank of Montreal. The Lassonde Group may, from time to time, acquire additional securities of Diamond Estates for investment purposes and to assist Diamond Estates with the execution of its strategic plan and may, from time to time, increase or decrease its beneficial ownership or control of Diamond Estates depending on market or other conditions, general economic conditions, Diamond Estates' business and financial condition and other factors.

This news release is being issued as required by National Instrument 62-103 - The Early Warning System and Related Take-Over Bid and Insider Reporting Issues and National Instrument 62-104 - Take-Over Bids and Issuer Bids and relates to Lassonde and Lassonde Holding, whose head office addresses are indicated below. data.title: Cathay General Bancorp 3Q 2026: Revenue $254.65M, EPS $1.43 — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Cathay General Bancorp's net interest income and earnings rose year over year, supported by higher interest income from loans and investment securities and lower deposit and FHLB borrowing costs. Higher equity-security gains and a TruPS redemption benefit lifted noninterest income, partly offset by a realized securities repositioning loss and higher operating expenses.

Business Highlights

  • Net interest income: Increased 11.8% to $211.9M, primarily on higher loan and investment-security income and lower deposit and FHLB advance costs.
  • Net interest margin: Rose to 3.52% from 3.31% in the year-earlier quarter.
  • Noninterest income: Rose 103.8%, driven mainly by a $32.8M increase in equity-security gains and a $3.1M TruPS redemption benefit; a $15.1M securities-sale loss partly offset gains.
